desc_short: 3D projects created during the 3D Creation course

title: La liseuse de bonnes aventures
desc_short: A very quick WEB project to illustrate poems written during a writing workshop.

title: AdBlockNot
desc_short: A short browser-based game built around the theme "depth" and the constraint "mise en abyme." Playing on the universal frustration of illegal streaming sites, AdBlockNot tasks players with closing a barrage of pop-up ads before time runs out, each ad-type demanding a different close strategy or facing the dreaded bluescreen.

title: CoffeePaws
desc_short: A cat café management sim built for HDM's web games showcase, developed with two fellow IMAC graduates after a prior project stalled. Players run a cozy, relaxing café, tending to feline customers in a soft, cute art style. Starting as project lead, writing the full game design document and specifications, the role expanded into 3D modeling and, after a mid-project team restructuring, into gameplay programming as well, carrying the prototype through to completion in Unity with a growing team of modelers and a UX/UI designer.

title: GhostHunt
desc_short: Multiplayer game project practising TCP/UDP protocols. Participation in a network programming project aimed at putting into practice the concepts studied in class (TCP and UDP protocols). The aim was to develop a multiplayer game with the ability to create simultaneous games and facilitate communication between players via an integrated messaging system.

title: Incognito
desc_short: A puzzle-platformer where players advance through each level to reach the exit by timing shifts in ambient lighting. Obstacles are color-coded, red, blue, or green, and only vanish when they match the camera's current light color. Forcing players to read the environment and switch between the three light states with precise timing to clear a path forward, all while staying hidden from patrolling guards who'll spot any careless move.

title: Infinite Loop
desc_short: An interactive p5.js flocking (boids) simulation created for a tutored university project, later exhibited at the Cité des Sciences during the "Ingénieurs Créatifs" event. The piece uses swarming word clusters tied to climate change disinformation to visually surface how misleading narratives cluster, spread, and reinforce one another, turning an algorithmic flocking behavior into a commentary on the mechanics of misinformation.

title: LightCorridor
desc_short: As a project for the  "Image Synthesis" course, we had to create a 3D game in which we travelled a long path full of obstacles using a ball.

title: Narai
desc_short: Design and development of a Japanese language learning website integrating various APIs, with the aim of creating an interactive teaching platform.

title: Occuloss
desc_short: An atmospheric horror-survival game inspired by the "look away and they move"mechanic. Shadowy creatures freeze under direct light but advance the instant a player's gaze or lamp's light. Players must balance staying alert to their surroundings with keeping sight of the exit, all while managing a fragile light source as their only defense.

title: TrickOrTreat
desc_short: World created in OpenGL in which the player must avoid will-o'-the-wisp boids within the given time limit I coded part of the world, but also made the 3D models.

title: UGExplorer
desc_short: Digital guided tour of the campus. Creation a website using VueJS and its design. We also created the itineraries for visiting the Descartes campus (Champs-sur-Marne).
